title: Create, open, and clone real Git workspaces
description: Implement local repository creation and repository open/clone lifecycle using the engine selected in TASK-2, with truthful progress and persistent workspace identity.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can initialize a local repository, open an existing supported workspace, or clone an authorized remote into a new workspace.
The app reports actual Git repository, remote, HEAD, default branch, and workspace status from the selected engine.
Clone/open failures and cancellation boundaries do not silently lose existing user data.
Workspace lifecycle and persistence behavior match the architecture decision and have focused tests.

steps.details: Follow its platform, persistence, auth, and deployment boundaries.
Use real Git operations and observable progress; do not simulate results.
Test success, invalid remote, interrupted operation, and existing-data protection.

technicalNotes: Never execute repository-provided scripts during clone/open.
Do not store secrets in the workspace or renderer.
